$comment: Runtime configuration for the discovery pipeline. Values here are safe to publish — no secrets. Secrets come only from the environment (TWITTERAPI_IO_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY).

ingestion.$lookbackComment: Deliberately > 24h. The overlap is harmless because deduplication is keyed on the source-native tweet id, and it stops results falling through the gap at a run boundary.
ingestion.$storeTweetTextComment: When false, only a SHA-256 of the text is persisted. Text is needed for extraction and reprocessing; set false if republishing third-party text in a public repo becomes a concern.
ingestion.$pacingComment: TwitterAPI.io returns 429 on rapid bursts (measured: ~40% of 37 back-to-back calls). Requests are paced, not just retried.

rawRetention.$comment: Raw per-day files older than this are pruned by the ingest job. Full API payloads are never committed — they go to a short-retention Actions artifact when debugging.

policy.$corroborationComment: A social-media observation with no external identifier (arXiv / DOI / OEIS / Erdős number / Lean or GitHub artifact) may not become a candidate on its own; it goes to the review queue instead. See ARCHITECTURE_ASSESSMENT.md §2.1.
